basic_details.job_title: VNIT Nagpur Senior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Physics at VNIT Nagpur has invited applications for the post of Senior Research Fellow (SRF) to work on a CSIR funded research project. The last date to apply is 7 December 2026. The advertisement and the application form are linked on the VNIT Nagpur notice page, which was posted on 6 November 2026.

how_to_apply: The notice page carries two links, one for the advertisement and one for the application form. The page text itself does not give the qualification, the mode of submission, the address or the documents to attach, so these are to be read in the linked advertisement and form. The last date to apply is 7 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: VNIT Nagpur Senior Research Fellow (SRF) at a Glance
content_sections.text: The notice page does not specify the number of vacancies, the age limit, the pay, the application fee or the selection process.

content_sections.heading: About VNIT Nagpur
content_sections.text: VNIT Nagpur is the institute in Nagpur that is carrying out this recruitment. The post is attached to a research project funded by CSIR and run in the institute's Department of Physics.

rows.details: Application form linked on the notice page
